findings.description: In the five neutral views the overskirt still reads as a plain cone, with no clearly visible repeated knife pleats or readable lamé surface. The larger panel-local relief did not make the skirt construction legible at product-view scale.

Crouch and sit views show the flared skirt panels lifting and overlapping across the thighs and behind the body; prone remains a broad disk-like flare. The new pleat relief has not resolved the pose deformation and adds no convincing drape.
The neutral front, back, and side renders still show triangular faceting across the lower bodice/waist and an uneven projecting jacket-to-skirt transition at the rear and sides.

nextAction: V125 applied a stronger panel-local pleat hypothesis, but direct inspection of all five views and six poses still shows an unreadable cone-like skirt, pose panel overlap, and lower bodice/rear-waist artifacts. Keep REJECT. The next prototype should address garment identity and the actual skirt silhouette/pose envelope, with a direct render loop; do not treat the pattern-declared pleat dimensions as acceptance. Fit, deformation/weights, shape keys, Unity/VRChat execution, package and release remain unapproved.
